title: rewrite a merged change as a sentence
provenance: The squash-commit description of a real merged change, omnibase_core dca2ee2ce068461d0614a25d67158226666dc668.
prompt:
Rewrite this merged change's description as one release-note sentence for a reader who has not seen the code. Keep the ticket identifier OMN-18056 and the name `binds_ac` exactly as written. Add nothing the description does not state. At most 45 words.

CHANGE (omnibase_core#1666):
feat(OMN-18056): a dod_evidence item can declare which acceptance criteria it covers

* feat(OMN-18056): a dod_evidence item can declare which acceptance criteria it covers

Adds `binds_ac` to ModelDodEvidenceItem. Until now the relation between a
ticket's acceptance criteria and its evidence items was not merely undeclared
across the corpus, it was UNDECLARABLE: `extra="forbid"` meant a contract
that tried to state it would fail to parse. So the only question the evidence
autoclose sweep could ask of a green verdict was how many checks passed,
never which criterion any of them covered.

Measured (DoD closeout sweep run 2, 2026-09-08): 8 of 9 adjudicated sprint
tickets satisfied the closer's full flip predicate and 7 of those 8 were not
done, because in every held case the criterion that decides the ticket was
bound to no check. A corpus grep across all 8709 contracts for any binding
field returned 0 files, positive control `dod_evidence` 8708.

Optional and defaulted, so every existing contract keeps parsing unchanged;
`extra="forbid"` stays, since forbidding the undeclared is exactly why the
field was needed rather than a rule to route around.

Honest limit, stated in the model: this is the author's CLAIM. A consumer can
verify a named check ran and was probative; it cannot verify the check proves
the criterion. What it removes is the silent case.

* feat(OMN-18056): the governance item model carries the same acceptance binding

ModelContractDodItem is what the DoD verifier validates a contract's items against; a binding declared only on the receipt-gate model would be rejected THERE as an unknown field, so a contract could not carry it at all. One meaning, two owners, added together.

---------

Respond with the answer only. Do not show your reasoning, do not narrate your steps, and do not preface the answer with anything.
